cases.sentence: Сохрани меня, Боже, ведь в Тебе ищу я ___.
cases.translation: Keep me, God, for in you I seek refuge.
cases.explain: Прибежище is the direct object of the verb ищу (seek), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господу я сказал, Ты мой ___, кроме Тебя нет у меня блага.
cases.translation: I said to the Lord, You are my Sovereign; apart from you I have no good thing.
cases.explain: Владыка is a predicate nominative, referring back to the subject, taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: А святые, которые на ___, величавы они, в них вся моя радость.
cases.translation: As for the saints on the earth, they are the glorious ones, in whom is all my delight.
cases.explain: The prepositional case земле with the preposition на (on) indicates location.

cases.sentence: Пусть множится скорби у тех, кто пойдет за чужими ___.
cases.translation: Those who run after other gods will suffer sorrows.
cases.explain: The genitive case богов after the preposition за (after) indicates the thing one pursues.

cases.sentence: Не залью я кровавых их возлияний, не поминут их имен мои ___.
cases.translation: I will not pour out libations of blood to them or take up their names on my lips.
cases.explain: Уста (lips) is the direct object of the verb поминут (will invoke/mention), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь, мой лучший удел и мой ___, Ты держишь мой жребий.
cases.translation: Lord, you have assigned me my portion and my cup; you have made my lot secure.
cases.explain: Кубок is the direct object in the parallel phrase with удел (portion), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Восхвалю Господа, наставляющего меня, даже ночью ___ мое меня учит.
cases.translation: I praise the Lord, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.
cases.explain: Сердце is the subject of the verb учит (instructs), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ты показал мне ___ жизни, Ты исполнишь меня радостью пред лицом твоим.
cases.translation: You show me the path of life; you fill me with joy in your presence.
cases.explain: Путь is the direct object of the verb показал (showed), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: Сохрани меня, Боже, ведь в Тебе ищу я прибежище.
reading.question: Where does the psalmist seek refuge?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states в Тебе ищу я прибежище (in You I seek refuge).

reading.ru: Господу я сказал, Ты мой Владыка, кроме Тебя нет у меня блага.
reading.question: What does the psalmist declare about God?
options: God is his Sovereign and apart from Him there is no good
There are other gods like the Lord
reading.correct: God is his Sovereign and apart from Him there is no good
reading.explain: The text says Ты мой Владыка (You are my Sovereign) and кроме Тебя нет у меня блага (apart from You there is no good for me).

reading.ru: А святые, которые на земле, величавы они, в них вся моя радость.
reading.question: What does the psalmist value about the saints on earth?
options: They are glorious and his source of delight
They are far away and distant
reading.correct: They are glorious and his source of delight
reading.explain: The verse says святые величавы они (the saints are glorious) and в них вся моя радость (in them is all my delight).

reading.ru: Пусть множится скорби у тех, кто пойдет за чужими богами.
reading.question: What will happen to those who follow other gods?
reading.explain: The verse states пусть множится скорби (let sorrows multiply) for those who pursue чужими богами (other gods).

reading.ru: Господь, мой лучший удел и мой кубок, Ты держишь мой жребий.
reading.question: What role does the Lord play in the psalmist's life?
options: He is the psalmist's portion and secures his lot
reading.correct: He is the psalmist's portion and secures his lot
reading.explain: The verse declares Господь мой лучший удел и кубок (the Lord is my portion and cup) and Ты держишь жребий мой (You hold my lot secure).

reading.ru: Всегда я видел Господа перед собой, Он по правую руку от меня, я не поколеблюсь.
reading.question: What assurance does this verse express?
options: The constant presence of God at the psalmist's right hand ensures stability
God is far away and absent
The psalmist is alone and helpless
reading.correct: The constant presence of God at the psalmist's right hand ensures stability
reading.explain: The psalmist states Всегда я видел Господа (I have always seen the Lord), Он по правую руку (He is at my right hand), therefore я не поколеблюсь (I will not be shaken).
